messages:
Beth (PM): Quick sync — we need to finalize launch gate + acceptance criteria for the Eval‑Sentry recommendations feature (batching / caching / quantization suggestions). Customer asks from DataScale and FinServ are pushing for early pilot. Goal: MVP pilot by end of Q2. Who can call out hard blockers?
Anna (Eng): I can take infra/ops constraints. Main issues: live telemetry for prefix hits, rollout safe mode, and compatibility with Dedicated.
Sanjay (ML): From model side: quantization recs require per‑model offline evals. We need representative prompt sets to avoid regressions. ETA ~3 weeks for initial eval harness.
Kai (Solutions): DataScale wants explicit per-route batching recs and a sample config they can drop in. FinServ needs KMS audit + opt‑out toggle per model. Both want simple acceptance tests.
Beth (PM): Acceptance test ideas: 1) end‑to‑end recommendation delivered in <200ms, 2) quant recs don't degrade baseline on defined eval set, 3) pilot customers can toggle per‑route. Agree? :thumbsup:
Anna (Eng): +1 on tests. For the <200ms target we need to scope caching: prefix cache for common prompts only, not full response caching. That keeps memory use sane.
Sanjay (ML): Suggest we ship the quantization advice as a confidence score + recommended bitwidth and expected perf delta. Avoid hard auto‑apply in MVP.
Kai (Solutions): Could we provide a sample snippet? e.g.:
```
recs: {
  batching: {max_batch: 16, batch_window_ms: 10},
  caching: {prefix_cache: true, ttl_ms: 60000},
  quant: {recommended: "int8", estimated_throughput_gain: "1.8x"}
}
```
Beth (PM): That snippet is perfect for customer docs. Ops question: what's the rollout plan if a rec causes perf regression?
Anna (Eng): Rollout plan idea: canary -> monitor token latency & error rate -> automatic rollback on >5% tail latency regression or >2% error spike. We should expose those thresholds as flags.
Sanjay (ML): We'll hook eval‑triggered alerts: if a new model/quant profile drops eval score beyond a threshold on the canonical prompt set, send alert to the pilot channel and mark rec as "needs review".
Beth (PM): Ok. Prioritization ask: what do we need for MVP (must have vs nice to have)?
Anna (Eng): Must: prefix caching instrumentation, per‑route opt toggle, basic canary/rollback. Nice: autosuggest tuning by workload type, per‑tenant default profiles.
Sanjay (ML): Must: eval harness + baseline prompt sets, quant recommendation heuristics. Nice: auto‑tune suggestion loop.
Kai (Solutions): Must: sample configs + clear acceptance checklist for customers. Nice: one‑click import into Dedicated config.
Beth (PM): Timeline proposal: lock scope this week, dev spike next 2 weeks, internal pilot late in sprint 3, external pilot with DataScale & FinServ sprint 5. Anyone think that's optimistic?
Anna (Eng): Spike OK. But we need 1 extra SWE for the canary automation to hit that timeline.
Sanjay (ML): ML work aligns with spike + 3 weeks. Fine.
Beth (PM): Action items: @Anna please list infra tasks by EOD, @Sanjay list eval datasets and run plan, @Kai draft customer acceptance checklist. I'll compile launch gate doc.
Devex Bot: Link to tracker created: https://redwood.example/issue/OPT‑REC‑426 — add estimates and tag owners.
Kai (Solutions): Noted, starting checklist now.
Beth (PM): Thanks — will follow up with a 15m sync tomorrow. :calendar:
